import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

W = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main"
path = "unpacked/word/document.xml"

tree = ET.parse(path)
root = tree.getroot()

# Preserve original namespace prefixes on serialization
for key, val in root.attrib.items():
    if key == "xmlns":
        ET.register_namespace("", val)
    elif key.startswith("xmlns:"):
        ET.register_namespace(key.split(":", 1)[1], val)

headlines = []
for p in root.iter("{%s}p" % W):
    text = "".join(t.text or "" for t in p.iter("{%s}t" % W))
    if text and text.isupper():
        for r in p.iter("{%s}r" % W):
            run_has_text = any((t.text or "").strip() for t in r.iter("{%s}t" % W))
            if not run_has_text:
                continue
            rpr = r.find("{%s}rPr" % W)
            if rpr is None:
                rpr = ET.Element("{%s}rPr" % W)
                r.insert(0, rpr)
            if rpr.find("{%s}u" % W) is None:
                u = ET.SubElement(rpr, "{%s}u" % W)
                u.set("{%s}val" % W, "single")
        headlines.append(text)

tree.write(path, encoding="ascii", xml_declaration=True)

# Verify: re-read and report
check = ET.parse(path)
u_count = sum(1 for _ in check.getroot().iter("{%s}u" % W))
raw = open(path, encoding="ascii").read()
print("Headlines underlined: %d" % len(headlines))
for h in headlines:
    print("  - %s" % h)
print("w:u elements in file: %d" % u_count)
print("entity escaping preserved: %s" % ("•" in raw))
print("xml:space preserved: %s" % ("xml:space=\"preserve\"" in raw))

import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

for text, underlined in headlines:
    print("HEADLINE: %s | underlined=%s" % (text, underlined))

    len(headlines), all(u for _, u in headlines)))

# Ensure body text was not underlined

    text = "".join(t.text or "" for t in p.iter("{%s}t" % W))
